offering_description.value: Produces lithium compounds for batteries, bromine-based flame retardants and other bromine specialties, and refining catalysts. Sells mainly to battery makers, electronics, oil refiners and industrial manufacturers. Manufactures from brine and mined resources at chemical plants worldwide.

primary_products.value: lithium carbonate and hydroxide; bromine and brominated flame retardants; refinery catalysts; polymer and specialty chemical additives

primary_services.value: catalyst recycling and regeneration; tolling and custom manufacturing

customer_segment.value: B2B: battery and EV makers, oil refiners, electronics and plastics manufacturers, chemical and pharmaceutical companies

end_markets.value: electric vehicles and energy storage; consumer electronics; petroleum refining; construction; pharmaceuticals and agriculture

revenue_model.value: product sales: lithium, bromine and catalyst products sold under supply contracts and spot sales; service fees: catalyst regeneration and custom manufacturing

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: extracts lithium brine and bromine, sold to battery and chemical producers; OEM / manufacturer: converts brine, ores and metals into specialty chemicals and catalysts for industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia (notably China, Japan, Korea), Middle East and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: lithium, bromine specialties and catalysts, all chemical products sharing technology and industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term contracts with battery makers, refiners and large industrial customers; distributors / dealers: distributors for smaller specialty chemical customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical manufacturing and mining under environmental, safety and chemical registration rules (EPA, OSHA, REACH)
